cases.title: EXPLODE on a new pit P8 with no pipe says P8 is now plain linework and has left the schedule with no pipe clause, and one U brings the pit back
cases.plan_item: UX-EDIT-04 EXPLODE, the no-pipe wording (daily card D16 assertion 1, second sentence)
cases.expected: PIT at 150000,-80000 (cover 19.000, three Esc) places one pit P8 with no pipe. Selecting that pit block and typing EXPLODE prints 'P8 is now plain linework and has left the schedule. U restores it.' and no 'pipe(s) now have ends' clause; the pit block's handle is gone from the drawing; one U echoes EXPLODE and the same pit block handle is back on layer STORMWATER PIT.
cases.why_not_unit: The line comes from CE watching a real EXPLODE of its own block in a live drawing.
not_automated: The look of the exploded linework is a picture item.
The Pit Schedule is not opened (N02 proves the schedule side for P3); this case proves the wording branch and the U.
cases.first_failure: no match for /(^|\| )EXPLODE( \||$)/ in: Command: | Command: U | EXPLODE
